title: Global memory retention policy for episodic logs
body: Keep episodes for 90 days; allow per-project override. Void only via internal tool; never delete by default.

title: Use per-conversation atomic sequences for messages/episodes
body: Implement DB-side sequence per conversation to prevent duplicates under concurrency; assign within transaction on insert.

title: MVP: endConversation writes summary milestone + episode
body: Shipped endConversation workflow: stores assistant msg, optional milestone item, and conversation_end episode; sets convo status ended.

title: Reject writes to ended conversations (default)
body: storeUserMessage/storeAssistantMessage/trackActiveFile/recordEpisode must reject if conversations.status='ended'; allow postmortem episodes only if enabled.

title: Exclude redacted messages from getRecentMessages
body: Default queries filter status='redacted'; internal policy can request inclusion for audit-only operations.

title: Active files upsert key and access counters
body: trackActiveFile upserts by (conversation_id, repo_root, path), sets status active, increments access_count, updates last_accessed_at, and bumps convo last_activity_at.

title: Support global knowledge items (conversation_id null)
body: Allow items with conversation_id null to be included in getComprehensiveContext across conversations; used for org-wide policies and defaults.

title: Context assembler returns messages/files/episodes/knowledge
body: Implemented getComprehensiveContext to bundle recent messages, active files, recent episodes, and active knowledge items (scoped + global).

title: Memory stats must never return negative or null aggregates
body: getMemoryStats computes counts for messages, active files, knowledge items by type/status, and episodes; validate aggregates before responding.

title: Health check requires read/write on required collections
body: checkHealth reports healthy only if DB connection is up and required collections are readable/writable; fail fast on permission issues.

title: Messages are stored with role and status='stored'
body: storeUserMessage/storeAssistantMessage insert messages with correct role and status stored; update conversations.last_activity_at on write.

title: Episode sequence assigned atomically per conversation
body: recordEpisode uses the next per-conversation sequence (transactional) and updates last_activity_at; retries must not duplicate sequence numbers.

title: Added redaction handling in message retrieval
body: Deployed message retrieval filters and admin override hook; verified ordering by sequence desc then created_at desc.

title: Conversation init sets banner_text when available
body: initConversation creates conversations row with status active and timestamps; may set banner_text (generateBanner equivalent) and returns assembled context.

title: Token counting optional; omit when not available
body: Stats and retrieval can use token_count if present; do not block writes when tokenization fails; log separately in episodes.

title: Enforce strict ended-conversation write lock
body: Earlier policy allowed file access updates after end; tightened to reject all writes by default except postmortem episodes when enabled.

title: Ended-conversation write lock v2 (postmortem only)
body: Clarifies enforcement: reject normal writes when ended; permit only episodes.kind='postmortem' if feature flag enabled; audit all exceptions.

title: Rate-limit memory writes per conversation
body: Apply burst limits to message/episode/file writes; return 429 with retry-after; record rate_limit episodes for observability.
